profile_text.body:
Microsoft is a public company headquartered in Redmond, Washington, founded in 1975 and trading as MSFT. According to its website, the company offers Power Automate, a workflow automation platform that uses AI, digital, and robotic process automation to automate business processes across apps, systems, and websites. The company describes Power Automate as capable of automating "across nearly unlimited systems, desktop apps, and websites," and highlights a customer case where generative AI and Power Automate reduced a carrier data validation process from over 100 people to just a few.

Microsoft's AI product portfolio spans multiple categories: Azure OpenAI Service provides OpenAI models in Azure regions with enterprise content filtering and data residency controls; Azure Machine Learning is an MLOps platform with AutoML and a responsible AI toolkit; Microsoft Copilot is embedded across Microsoft 365 applications; and Microsoft Power Automate AI offers enterprise workflow automation with Copilot integration and data loss prevention features. Additional products include Teams AI for meeting recaps, SharePoint AI for enterprise content intelligence, Semantic Kernel and the Microsoft Agent Framework for agent orchestration and development, AutoGen for multi-agent conversation frameworks, Microsoft Designer for image generation, and Clipchamp AI for video editing.

Microsoft faces two lawsuits filed in U.S. District Court for the Southern District of New York: The New York Times Co. v. Microsoft Corp. and OpenAI and Authors Guild v. OpenAI, Inc. The company reported revenue of $331.839 billion for the fiscal year ended June 30, 2026, and maintains substantial legal exposure with 96 reported cases in Washington state.
